text:
Lena R: FYI platform team is introducing a normalized routing header next week: X-Redwood-Route. Two supported values: `cost` and `latency`. They also want a small `X-Quota-Tag` so the console can attribute requests to quotas. Asking SDKs to canonicalize casing and accept legacy `route_hint`/`routeHint` as fallbacks.

Arjun P: We should avoid changing default behavior for GA. Propose SDKs expose an explicit `route` parameter and opt-in via env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE=off|opt-in|mirror`.

Ivy L: DevEx: opt-in by default for GA, but provide a helper that transparently remaps legacy headers when enabled. Console UX request: surface a per-request "applied policy" column in the request samples so teams can validate remaps.

Tim (platform): Server plan: accept legacy names for 120 days, add telemetry event `routing.legacy_seen` sampled at 0.1%. We'll keep default routing unchanged server-side. SDKs should send `X-Quota-Tag` with a simple runtime identifier like `sdk:py:1.2.0` when possible.

deploy-bot: routing-api compat flip scheduled -> canary 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC (https://deploys.redwood.internal/routing-api/compat) :rocket:

Arjun P: For Go we'll add a small wrapper: `WithRoutePolicy(policy string)` on the client builder and `REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE` env support. Default = off. Will include an info-level log when remapping occurs.

Lena R: Please emit a telemetry counter `sdk.route_remap` with tags {sdk, lang, mode}. Console needs that metric for the dashboard tile. Also add a sampled debug log with raw headers when remap happens, linked from the tile.

Ivy L: Draft Python helper (to include in RFC):
```python
def ensure_route_headers(headers, route=None):
    # explicit route param wins, then existing header keys, then noop
    if route:
        headers['X-Redwood-Route'] = route
    else:
        for k in ('X-Redwood-Route','x-redwood-route','route_hint','routeHint'):
            if k in headers:
                headers['X-Redwood-Route'] = headers[k]
                break
    headers['X-Quota-Tag'] = headers.get('X-Quota-Tag', f"sdk:py:{__version__}")
```

Arjun P: Go pseudo:
```go
if mode == "mirror" {
  // copy route_hint -> X-Redwood-Route
}
client.WithRoutePolicy("latency")
```

Tim (platform): We'll publish per-tenant sample rates for `routing.legacy_seen`. Console will show a new "Routing fidelity" panel listing mismatch rate and example traces. We'll link to SDK migration docs.

Lena R: Agreed: ship SDK helpers behind feature flag. Default = off for public releases. For internal canary we can enable `mirror` and monitor telemetry. Add CHANGELOG guidance and a short migration snippet for each language.

Ivy L: I'll add opt-in snippets to Python/TS docs and a quick section in the release notes. Also create a small FAQ: "What if my app sets both headers?" — we'll state explicit param > X-Redwood-Route > legacy keys.

Arjun P: Will open PR for Go client by EOD with tests and telemetry emission.

Tim (platform): Confirmed: legacy header acceptance until 2026-08-31. We'll emit `routing.header_mismatch` when both legacy and new header present. Thanks everyone.

Lena R: Thanks team. Quick check-in tomorrow 9:30 PT to review telemetry dashboards before canary. :white_check_mark:
